description: Phase 3 UI mask-edit hard debug manifest for batch prompt-vs-instruction testing. Paths default to /data/wqx/flowedit/data/<dataset> and can be overridden by the batch runner.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained breast cancer histopathology showing scattered invasive tumor nests in abundant stroma with small necrotic/debris foci and mild lymphocytic infiltrate; tumor burden is low.
cases.new_prompt: Increase the invasive tumor burden moderately by expanding irregular tumor nests into adjacent stromal tissue while preserving the existing necrotic foci and lymphocytic infiltrate.
cases.notes: Many small tumor components make contour placement and projection selection intentionally difficult.
cases.instruction: Moderately increase invasive tumor burden by expanding irregular tumor nests into adjacent stroma; preserve necrosis/debris and lymphocytic infiltrate.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained breast cancer histopathology with sparse tumor islands embedded in extensive necrosis/debris and only a small amount of stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Resolve most of the necrosis/debris and replace it with viable stromal tissue, without increasing the tumor burden.
cases.notes: Large necrosis-to-stroma rewrite should expose backfill and area-control failures.
cases.instruction: Resolve most necrosis/debris and replace it with viable stroma; keep tumor burden unchanged.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained breast cancer histopathology with tumor nests surrounded by dense lymphocytic immune infiltrate, sparse stroma, and visible blood vessel tissue.
cases.new_prompt: Decrease the lymphocytic immune infiltrate substantially and replace it with stromal tissue, keeping tumor burden approximately unchanged.
cases.instruction: Substantially decrease lymphocytic immune infiltrate and replace it with stroma; keep tumor burden stable.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained breast cancer histopathology with fragmented tumor, stromal tissue, focal necrosis/debris, and prominent lymphocytic infiltrate.
cases.new_prompt: Increase desmoplastic stromal response around the tumor nests while keeping the tumor burden and necrosis approximately stable.
cases.instruction: Increase desmoplastic stromal response around the tumor nests; keep tumor burden and necrosis stable.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained colorectal histopathology showing moderately differentiated malignant glands scattered in abundant stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Upgrade the malignant glands to poorly differentiated high grade carcinoma in-place, without changing the total gland area.
cases.notes: Tests grade upgrade versus generic tumor burden increase confusion.
cases.instruction: Upgrade the malignant glands from moderately differentiated to poorly differentiated high grade carcinoma in-place; do not change total gland area.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained colorectal histopathology with adenomatous glands occupying a small fraction of the patch and surrounded by stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Transform the adenomatous glands into moderately differentiated carcinoma in-place, preserving the gland boundaries.
cases.instruction: Transform adenomatous glands into moderately differentiated carcinoma in-place while preserving the gland boundaries.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained colorectal histopathology with multiple fragmented poorly differentiated glands in abundant stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Increase the poorly differentiated tumor gland burden moderately by expanding the existing irregular glands into adjacent stroma.
cases.instruction: Moderately increase poorly differentiated tumor gland burden by expanding existing irregular glands into adjacent stroma.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained colorectal histopathology with scattered poorly differentiated glands in stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Decrease the poorly differentiated tumor gland burden by replacing a portion of the gland area with stroma.
cases.instruction: Decrease poorly differentiated tumor gland burden by replacing part of the gland area with stroma.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained lung squamous cell carcinoma with low tumor burden, abundant stroma, focal necrosis, mild immune infiltrate, normal epithelium, and patch-edge background.
cases.new_prompt: Add moderate intratumoral necrosis within the existing tumor while preserving surrounding stroma and immune infiltrate.
cases.instruction: Add moderate intratumoral necrosis within the existing tumor; preserve surrounding stroma and immune infiltrate.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained lung adenocarcinoma biopsy with tumor, stroma, necrosis, immune infiltrate, other tissue, and substantial background at the patch edge.
cases.new_prompt: Increase stromal immune infiltration around the tumor and necrotic regions while keeping tumor burden stable.
cases.instruction: Increase stromal immune infiltration around tumor and necrotic regions; keep tumor burden stable.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained lung adenocarcinoma with high tumor burden, stromal tissue, focal necrosis, immune infiltrate, and background near the patch margin.
cases.new_prompt: Decrease tumor burden moderately by replacing selected peripheral tumor regions with stroma, while preserving necrosis and immune infiltrate.
cases.instruction: Moderately decrease tumor burden by replacing selected peripheral tumor regions with stroma; preserve necrosis and immune infiltrate.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained lung adenocarcinoma with moderate tumor burden, necrosis, dense immune infiltrate, sparse stroma, and background near the edge.
cases.new_prompt: Increase tumor burden into the immune-rich stroma and decrease the immune infiltrate, while leaving the existing necrosis approximately unchanged.
cases.notes: Planner may defer immune decrease when tumor increase is present; keep expected list to catch ordering/defer behavior.
cases.instruction: Increase tumor burden into immune-rich stroma and decrease immune infiltrate; leave existing necrosis unchanged.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained oral squamous cell carcinoma with carcinoma occupying much of the tissue region, mixed with non-carcinoma tissue and substantial non-tissue background.
cases.new_prompt: Decrease carcinoma burden by replacing peripheral carcinoma with non-carcinoma tissue, without writing into the background.
cases.instruction: Decrease carcinoma burden by replacing peripheral carcinoma with non-carcinoma tissue; avoid background.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained oral squamous cell carcinoma with carcinoma and a large amount of non-carcinoma tissue plus background at the patch margin.
cases.new_prompt: Increase carcinoma burden moderately by expanding carcinoma into adjacent non-carcinoma tissue, avoiding the background.
cases.instruction: Moderately increase carcinoma burden by expanding carcinoma into adjacent non-carcinoma tissue; avoid background.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained oral squamous cell carcinoma with carcinoma, non-carcinoma tissue, and a large background portion.
cases.new_prompt: Decrease carcinoma burden mildly by converting a boundary-rich portion of carcinoma to non-carcinoma tissue.
cases.instruction: Mildly decrease carcinoma burden by converting a boundary-rich portion of carcinoma to non-carcinoma tissue.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained oral squamous cell carcinoma with carcinoma and non-carcinoma tissue at 40x magnification.
cases.new_prompt: H&E stained oral squamous cell carcinoma with carcinoma and non-carcinoma tissue at 40x magnification, described with slightly clearer wording.
cases.instruction: Do not change any tissue labels; keep carcinoma and non-carcinoma tissue unchanged.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained prostate biopsy with Gleason pattern 3 dominant tumor and a small Gleason pattern 4 component in abundant stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Upgrade the Gleason pattern 3 tumor areas to Gleason pattern 4 in-place, without increasing total tumor burden.
cases.instruction: Upgrade prostate tumor from Gleason pattern 3 to Gleason pattern 4 in-place; keep total tumor burden unchanged.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained prostate biopsy with mixed Gleason pattern 4 and Gleason pattern 5 tumor in abundant stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Upgrade the Gleason pattern 4 tumor component to Gleason pattern 5 in-place while preserving overall tumor area.
cases.instruction: Upgrade prostate tumor from Gleason pattern 4 to Gleason pattern 5 in-place; preserve overall tumor area.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained prostate biopsy with fragmented Gleason pattern 4 tumor occupying a modest fraction of the patch and abundant stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Increase Gleason pattern 4 tumor burden moderately by expanding tumor into adjacent stroma, without changing the Gleason grade.
cases.instruction: Moderately increase Gleason pattern 4 tumor burden by expanding tumor into adjacent stroma; keep Gleason grade unchanged.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained prostate biopsy with benign normal epithelium, stroma, and a small amount of Gleason pattern 3 and 4 tumor.
cases.new_prompt: Transform a focal benign normal epithelial region into low grade malignant Gleason pattern 3 tumor.
cases.instruction: Transform focal benign normal epithelium into Gleason pattern 3 low-grade malignant tumor.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained metastatic melanoma with many fragmented tumor nests in abundant stroma.
cases.new_prompt: Increase melanoma tumor burden moderately by expanding the fragmented tumor nests into adjacent stroma.
cases.instruction: Moderately increase melanoma tumor burden by expanding fragmented tumor nests into adjacent stroma.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained primary melanoma with tumor, stroma, focal necrosis, and blood vessel tissue.
cases.new_prompt: Add focal intratumoral necrosis within the melanoma tumor while preserving nearby stroma and blood vessels.
cases.instruction: Add focal intratumoral necrosis within the melanoma tumor; preserve nearby stroma and blood vessels.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained metastatic melanoma with high tumor burden, necrosis, and substantial background at the patch edge.
cases.new_prompt: Decrease melanoma tumor burden significantly by replacing peripheral tumor with stroma-like tissue, preserving the existing necrosis and avoiding background.
cases.notes: Selected to stress tumor decrease when stroma is absent or very limited in the visible mask.
cases.instruction: Significantly decrease melanoma tumor burden by replacing peripheral tumor with stroma-like tissue; preserve necrosis and avoid background.

cases.old_prompt: H&E stained primary melanoma with tumor, stroma, epidermis, and blood vessel tissue.
cases.new_prompt: Increase desmoplastic stroma around the melanoma tumor while preserving epidermis and blood vessel tissue.
cases.instruction: Increase desmoplastic stroma around the melanoma tumor; preserve epidermis and blood vessel tissue.
